The loose loops mean the wheel’s internal shoulder did not print reliably. I’ve changed the wheel to two bolted halves, each printed with its bearing pocket facing upward, so there is no roof to bridge. Please discard the failed wheel. Since the bearing fits and spacer dimensions remain unverified, this revision is still for unloaded bench testing only.
